latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the skill.
- Generates and scores 10 email subject line variants using 7 open-rate predictor signals.
- Recommends the top 3 subject lines for A/B testing, with rationale and full A/B test setup guidance.
- Analyzes for spam triggers, character count, and mobile truncation for each variant.
- Provides industry benchmark data and preheader suggestions for optimal email performance.
- Includes commands for variant generation, scoring, competitor analysis, and session history management.
